message.content: {"question":"We are given a matrix A ∈ R^n,n, symmetric and positive definite, and its Choleski factorization A = R^T R. Which one of the following statements is surely correct?","options":{"A":"the factorization always exists but it is not unique","B":"the uniqueness of the factorization depends od the rank of matrix A","C":"the factorization does not always exist, but when it exists it is unique","D":"the factorization always exists and it is unique"},"correct":"D"}
